title: Top 4 Content Resources From 2023
summary: To celebrate the new year, let’s take a look back at some of this year’s major content resources.
body_markdown:
To celebrate the new year, let’s take a look back at some of this year’s major content resources that will help you laugh, learn, and grow.


## #1: Case Study: Ryvid’s Anthem EV Bike Races Through Production


Discover why this innovator in the micromobility powersport space chose Xometry to produce 50% of the parts found in its flagship electric motorcycle, the Ryvid Anthem.


**[Read the Case Study](https://www.xometry.com/resources/case-studies/ryvid/)**


## #2: Explore Our Metal Finishes Gallery


From cosmetic finishes like electropolishing to functional options such as passivation and hardcoat anodizing, we have the solutions to meet your needs. Explore and see our standard metal finish offerings; be sure to click the images to learn more about each finish.


**[Explore the Gallery](https://www.xometry.com/finishes/metal-finishes/)**


## #3: \[Webinar\] Trimming Costs, Keeping Quality: Tips for CNC Machining


Unpack actionable strategies and best practices for CNC machining by listening to this insightful webinar.


**[Watch the Webinar](https://www.xometry.com/resources/blog/recording-smart-cnc-design-tips/)**


## #4: Video: Will It Erode? - Part 1


In this "Will it..." video, we printed the "3D Benchy" using several different materials and processes and then ran several abrasion tests on them. Watch to find out which 3D printed plastic is truly the toughest of them all.
